title: Zero-Shot Super-Resolution using Deep Internal Learning
summary: Image-internal recurrence can provide useful information beyond a fixed external training distribution. This paper trains an image-specific network, which the current pilot budget does not permit; a cheaper distinct hypothesis would need its own justification.

title: Plug-and-Play Image Restoration with Deep Denoiser Prior
summary: Model-based inverse-problem methods can combine a learned prior with an explicit observation model. The paper uses a learned denoiser and iterative optimization; its reported gains do not establish gains for a different cheap postprocessor.

title: Super-Resolution via Image-Adapted Denoising CNNs: Incorporating External and Internal Learning
summary: Observation-model mismatch and input-image information can matter in SR. Its full learning procedure is outside the present frozen-weight budget; identify what a new distinct mechanism actually predicts, without claiming the paper proves your method.
